Definition: properly, made to slip, i.e. dislocated
BiblicalUsage: Muedeth is a foot slipped out of joint, dislocated — confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the picture is exact: a faithless friend in trouble does not just fail, he hurts to lean on.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
